decisions.statement: An opened line carries the leading whitespace of the line it opens under.
A line opened under a bullet carries that marker and the spacing after it.
A bullet marker is a hyphen, an asterisk or a plus.
A line opened under a numbered item carries the next number, that delimiter and that spacing.
The number carried is one past the number the item states rather than one past the list's count.
A number's delimiter is a full stop or a closing parenthesis.
A marker with no space after it is no marker.
An item with nothing after its marker ends the list.
A line opened under an item that ends the list carries its indent and no marker.
Nothing here reads the lines above the line handed in.

definition: the prefix a line opened under another line carries from it
